from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

m=(abs(R-G)<12)&(abs(G-B)<12)&(R>195)&(R<240)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(m)
print('cab n',m.sum(),'u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
for u in range(0,190,10):
    c=np.nonzero(m[:,u])[0]
    if len(c): print('u',u,'vtop',c.min(),'vbot',c.max())
" 2>/dev/null
